text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You were amazing! I cannot put my
gratitude into
words!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I will now accept this plushie and
accompany it
with all the sincerity I can
muster!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That just won't do! I will have it by my
side at
bedtime, when I eat, and in my
training sessions! I
vow to cherish it, for
the two of us will never be
apart!
choice_data_list_en: You don't have to go that far...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I will treasure this plushie because you're
the one
who gave it to me!
